_noteW: Blighted Quiver. Two BIN-confirmed magic-damage components, both curated as W bonusEffects (the calcs live in VarusWAbility/VarusW's mSpellCalculations; W itself has no direct 'cast' damage of its own -- it is a toggle/on-hit passive plus an active-empower utility, so no 'hits' key is written for W, only bonusEffects). (1) OnHitDamage (trigger onHit, fires on every basic attack): NamedDataValue(VarusWOnHitDamage) + StatByNamedDataValue(no mStat => AP, OnHitRatio=0.25) + StatByNamedDataValue(mStat=2, mStatFormula=2 => BONUS AD, OnHitADRatio=0.15) -- the live BIN carries a bonus-AD term (OnHitADRatio) the fandom mirror's older text ('7-11 + 25% AP') does not mention; the BIN (current patch) supersedes the wiki text as ground truth per the dynamic-lookup hard rule, and only the calc name/kind are curated here so it resolves live regardless of which patch changed the numbers. (2) MaxPercentHPPerStack (trigger onAbility, tagged Stacking + PercentMaxHp): ModifiedGameCalculation = PercentHPPerStack x3, i.e. the FULL 3-Blight-stack detonation magic damage Varus's OTHER abilities (Q/E/R) deal when they land on a target already carrying 3 Blight stacks (stacks applied by this same W's on-hit passive, or by R's full-stack application) -- 'Varus' other abilities consume stacks of Blight on enemies hit to deal bonus magic damage' per the wiki. HONESTY CAVEAT: modeled as onAbility (fires on every Q/W/E/R node per this project's existing BonusTrigger semantics), which (a) assumes the target already carries the full 3 stacks -- an upper-bound assumption, since stack count is not live-tracked by this engine -- and (b) will also technically fire on a W node itself even though W is the stack-APPLIER, not a consumer -- a known imprecision of the onAbility trigger's all-or-nothing scope, flagged here rather than silently accepted. (3) W-ACTIVE EMPOWERED Q (section-40, loop 548 -- was 'Deliberately NOT curated' until the Upgraded condition + charge-rider support existed): the Q-specific active-empower term is now the third rider -- trigger onAbility restricted appliesTo:[Q], conditionType Upgraded (UserAssumed, default UNMET = the pre-loop-548 floor; the M28 checkbox on the Q node asserts the toggle), metHpPercentCalc QEmpowerPercentHP (6% at rank 1) interpolating to metHpPercentMaxCalc MaxQEmpowerPercentHP (x1.5 = 9%) by the Q charge knob, hpBasis Missing so it lands as a DYNAMIC missing-health execute node. Rider order matters and is load-bearing: this effect is declared AFTER the blight rider, so its dynamic Missing reads the running HP after Q base + blight land -- the measured 2026-07-14 semantics (49 = 9% x 666 missing x 0.8333 at 518/1000). The blight rider itself now carries chargeAmpMaxDataValue VarusWMaxChargeHPDamage (1.5): a Q detonation amplifies x1->x1.5 by the same charge knob (unset knob = the Q anchor = full charge, matching _noteQ's anchor-at-max), while E/R detonations have no charge knob and stay plain -- the measured 112 vs 75 split.
